definitions.gloss: speaking voice; sound of talking; voices
definitions.explanation: The voice used in ordinary conversation, or the audible sound of people talking — as opposed to singing or shouting.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}から{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear voices from next door.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}は{優|やさ}しい。
{夜遅|よるおそ}く、{廊下|ろうか}で{小|ちい}さな{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}がした。
examples.english: Late at night, there were faint voices in the hallway.

notes:
Refers both to the quality of a person's conversational voice and to the sound of talking that one overhears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}し{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえる: to hear voices
- {話|はな}し{声|ごえ}が{大|おお}きい: to have a loud speaking voice
- {小|ちい}さな{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}: faint/quiet voices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歌声|うたごえ}: singing voice — the voice when singing rather than talking
- {声|こえ}: voice — the general word, without the specific sense of conversation
